note: Photo upgrade pass (travel-itinerary-photos skill). Portfolio-grade shots discovered via Google Images, pulled full-res from source pages (travelslovenia.org, Flickr, Pexels, tourism boards), self-hosted, contact-sheet reviewed by eye. 5 per carousel + 5 hero. The c-skocjan Postojna shots: genuine free-licensed Skocjan interiors do not exist (restricted photography) so Postojna Cave is used as the documented easier alternative, captioned honestly.

c-bled.alt: Bled island church silhouetted against a golden sunrise glow with a flawless symmetric reflection on the still lake, Julian Alps flanking the water.
Elevated panorama of the whole of Lake Bled at first light, the tiny island church mirrored in glowing water beneath the snow-dusted Julian Alps.
Bled Castle clinging to the top of a sheer vertical cliff above the lakeside town, autumn forest below and clear alpine sky beyond.
A traditional red pletna boat full of passengers glides across a calm, warmly lit Lake Bled with the castle perched on its cliff behind.
Mist drifts over a glassy long-exposure Lake Bled at dawn, the island church centered beneath soft pink and violet sunrise clouds.

c-vintgar.alt: The wooden boardwalk clings to the sheer cliff of Vintgar Gorge above a vivid emerald pool of the Radovna River in warm backlight.
Two hikers walk the cliffside walkway as the brilliant blue-emerald Radovna River rushes over rapids through the lush Vintgar Gorge.
Whitewater rapids of the Radovna River surge between towering moss-covered limestone canyon walls deep in Vintgar Gorge.
A wooden footbridge sweeps across Vintgar Gorge above the milky-blue rushing river, framed by steep green canyon walls.
The silky Šum waterfall at the end of Vintgar Gorge plunges into a vivid emerald plunge pool ringed by lush forest.

c-bohinj.alt: The Church of St John the Baptist and the stone arch bridge at Ribcev Laz mirrored in a glassy Lake Bohinj under a streaked sunset sky.
The A-shaped Savica waterfall splits over a grey limestone cliff and plunges into its emerald pool deep in the Triglav gorge.
The sweeping view from the Vogel cable car looking down over Lake Bohinj to the Bohinj basin and the Julian Alps beyond.
A bright yellow canoe glides across the glassy turquoise water of Lake Bohinj ringed by the forested Julian Alps.
A blazing pink and orange sunrise sky over the layered silhouettes of Mount Triglav and the Julian Alps with mist pooling in the valleys.

c-vrsic.alt: The bronze Zlatorog ibex statue perches on rocks above the turquoise water of Lake Jasna as the jagged Julian Alps catch first light behind.
A cobblestoned hairpin of the historic Russian Road on the Vrsic Pass curves past a dressed-stone retaining wall through the alpine forest.
The twin onion-domed wooden Russian Chapel stands among green spring larches at the foot of the Vrsic Pass, reached by a stone stairway.
The sheer north wall of Prisojnik rises above the Vrsic Pass, its rock features forming the famous Ajdovska Deklica pagan-girl face.
A sweeping view down the green Trenta valley from the Vrsic descent, forested slopes framing the Soca-source basin and the surrounding peaks.

c-soca.alt: Aerial view of the emerald Soča river looping in giant turquoise bends around the red-roofed town of Most na Soči deep in its green valley.
Two paddlers in red and blue kayaks gliding over the impossibly clear turquoise water of the Soča river between pale boulders.
The Great Soča Gorge (Velika korita) narrow slot of vivid turquoise water winding between sunlit golden and white limestone cliffs.
Kozjak waterfall dropping into a glowing emerald-green pool inside its cave-like rock amphitheater, a shaft of light striking the mossy wall.
Sweeping panorama from Svinjak over the green Soča valley with the river threading toward the snow-dusted peaks of the Julian Alps.

c-tolmin.alt: The vivid turquoise Tolminka river snaking through the deep, narrow Tolmin gorge between towering moss-draped limestone walls.
The Devil's Bridge (Hudičev most) spanning high across the top of the Tolmin gorge above the turquoise Tolminka, with the cliff-side boardwalk below.
Turquoise water of the Tolminka rushing over pale rocks at the confluence in Tolmin gorge, framed by moss-covered ledges and forest.
Wooden footbridge crossing the gorge above the turquoise Tolminka confluence, with hikers resting on a boulder in the clear summer water below.
Silky river rushing between the towering moss-covered canyon walls of Tolmin gorge beside the narrow cliff-hugging gravel path.

c-skocjan.alt: The Škocjan collapse doline, a huge cliff-walled green sinkhole plunging to the cave mouth with a hilltop church on the forested rim.
The Cerkvenik footbridge spanning the vast illuminated underground canyon of the Škocjan Caves, high above the Reka river gorge.
An illuminated chamber of Postojna Cave (the easier alternative near Škocjan), a towering stalagmite column and stalactite-draped walls glowing amber above a lone visitor for scale.
The Brilliant, Postojna Cave's famous snow-white five-metre stalagmite (not Škocjan), glowing beside an ornate column and mirrored in the still cave water.
Postojna Cave's colourful open electric train (not Škocjan) winding through a warmly lit stalactite gallery on its ride deep into the karst.

c-piran.alt: Golden-hour aerial of Piran's red-roofed peninsula jutting into the Adriatic, St George's church and bell tower glowing above the harbor.
Elevated view over Piran's whole peninsula and bell tower from St George's hill, a seagull gliding above the calm blue Adriatic.
Aerial view of Piran's oval Tartini Square with the Tartini statue, ringed by terracotta roofs, the marina and the open Adriatic beyond.
c-piran.credit: Pham Ngoc Anh · Google Images source

c-piran.alt: Tightly packed terracotta rooftops of Piran spilling down to the turquoise Adriatic with a lone sailboat on the horizon.
Colorful wooden fishing boats moored in Piran's little harbor beneath the old town's bell tower and pastel facades.
c-piran.credit: Daciana Cristina Visan · Google Images source

c-coast.alt: A red-hulled sailboat gliding past the dramatic layered flysch cliffs of Slovenia's Strunjan–Portoroz coast over turquoise water.
Swimmers in the clear turquoise shallows off a pebbly cove, Piran's colorful waterfront and bell tower across the bay.
Geometric evaporation basins of the Sečovlje saltworks near Piran, mirror-still water reflecting the sky between salt channels.
Portoroz's riviera bay: sailboats in the marina below the hillside grand hotels of Slovenia's main seaside resort.
c-coast.credit: Giuseppe Di Maria · Google Images source

c-coast.alt: A wrought-iron jetty reaching into a glassy Adriatic at twilight near Strunjan, the Piran skyline silhouetted under a pink-and-violet sky.

c-ljubljana.alt: Ljubljana Castle crowning its wooded hilltop above the red-tiled roofs and pink Franciscan church tower of the old town.
A copper Art-Nouveau dragon of Ljubljana's Dragon Bridge, wings spread, silhouetted against a glowing pastel sunset sky.
Plecnik's Triple Bridge arching over the emerald Ljubljanica River, framed by willows and the old town's pastel facades.
c-ljubljana.credit: Vito L. Tanzi · Google Images source

c-ljubljana.alt: The Ljubljanica embankment at blue hour, Plecnik's lantern-lit market colonnade reflected in the river as riverside cafe terraces glow with diners.
The salmon-pink Franciscan Church rising over Preseren Square beside the Triple Bridge and the Ljubljanica River in the old town.
